detail.longDescription: Aside from providing new vocabulary, the effect of technology on language – even a technology as transformative as writing – may be greatly overstated. This study predicts that "language use and evolution will also remain largely unaffected by major technological revolutions such as AI": https://www. pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2527 946123 # language # linguistics # technology # evolang # research # AI
